draft.title: Effects of the Black Death
card: In medieval Europe, most people were peasants who farmed land owned by a lord. Under feudalism, many were serfs, who were tied to the land and owed their lord work.
The Black Death killed so many people that there were far fewer workers. Lords needed labourers to farm their land, so workers became harder to find.
Survivors could ask for higher wages and more freedom, and many left to find better pay. This weakened feudalism, because lords had less control over their workers.
Rulers and lords often tried to hold wages down by law, and many peasants were angry. In 1381 this anger helped lead to the Peasants' Revolt in England.
draft.remember: Fewer workers gave survivors more bargaining power, and this weakened feudalism.

a.q: Why did survivors of the Black Death in Europe gain more bargaining power?
opts: Workers were scarce, so lords needed them
Lords were killed, so no one owned the land
Rulers wanted peasants to leave their villages
Fewer people meant less land needed farming
a.why: With so many dead, lords had trouble finding enough labourers, so workers could ask for better pay and freedom. The idea that no one owned the land is wrong, because lords still held their land and needed people to work it.
a.clue: Think about what lords needed and how hard it was to get.

b.q: In 1360, a lord in England finds that his serfs have left for villages where landowners pay more. What does this best show?
opts: Feudalism was weakening as lords lost control of workers
Feudalism was growing stronger as lords gained more land
The Black Death had made labour easier to find
Peasants no longer wanted to work on farms
b.why: Workers were scarce, so they could move to where pay was higher, and lords could not easily hold them. This shows lords losing control, which weakened feudalism. It is not stronger feudalism, because under feudalism serfs were tied to the land.
b.clue: Serfs were once tied to the land. What changed when workers became scarce?

a.best: Workers were scarce, so lords needed them

b.best: Feudalism was weakening as lords lost control of workers

problems.detail: "Lords needed labourers to farm their land, so workers became harder to find" gets the cause wrong. Workers were harder to find because so many had died, not because lords needed them. The sentence should link the scarcity to the deaths.
